test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 7 June 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
In the following passage, some words have been deleted. Read the passage carefully and select the most appropriate option to fill in each blank.

We have already said that inconsistency is not a matter of __________ education or lack of logical ______________.
solution:
The correct answer is "**inadequate, rigour**". 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Inadequate** means **not sufficient**.

 
 
• **Example:** *The time was **inadequate** to finish the exam. *
 
 
 
• **Rigour** means the **quality of being careful and detailed.** 
 
 
• **Example: ***The detective examed the site **rigorously **for clues. *
 
 
 
• Therefore, the appropriate option is "inadequate, rigour".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Indefinite** - not fixed.
 
• **Stupor** - almost unconscious 
 
• **Institutional **- connected to an institution or body.
 
• **Shiver** - trembling.
 
• **Inadvertent** - an unintentional action.
 
• **Snigger** - to laugh in an unpleasant way.
